barbell-back-squat|barbell-deadlift: Bar in view rising from the floor = deadlift; bar never in view (behind the neck) = squat.
barbell-back-squat|barbell-front-squat: Bar behind the neck, never in view = back squat; bar across the front delts, plates visible below the chin = front squat.
barbell-back-squat|goblet-squat: A single dumbbell held at the chest, looming large = goblet; nothing in view but the floor = back squat.
barbell-back-squat|hack-squat-machine: Shoulder pads and a fixed sled track = hack squat; a free bar behind the neck = back squat.
barbell-back-squat|standing-calf-raise-m: Only the heels move and the view barely bobs = calf raise; the whole room drops and rises = squat.
barbell-bench-press|dumbbell-bench-press: One bar with plates = barbell; two dumbbell heads that drift apart at the bottom = dumbbell.
barbell-bench-press|incline-barbell-benc: Ceiling straight above = flat bench; the ceiling and rack tilt toward the feet = incline.
barbell-bench-press|push-up: Floor rushes toward the face = push-up; ceiling above and a bar in the hands = bench press.
barbell-bent-over-row|barbell-curl: Standing upright, bar curls up to the chin with supinated grip = curl; torso hinged, bar pulled to the belly = row.
barbell-bent-over-row|dumbbell-row: Torso hinged over one bar with plates = barbell row; one dumbbell with the other hand on a bench = dumbbell row.
barbell-curl|dumbbell-biceps-curl: One straight bar with both hands = barbell curl; two separate dumbbells = dumbbell curl.
barbell-deadlift|romanian-deadlift: Plates start on the floor every rep = deadlift; the bar never touches down and the hips hinge = RDL.
barbell-front-squat|goblet-squat: Single dumbbell at the chest = goblet; a bar across the front delts with plates at the sides = front squat.
barbell-hip-thrust|romanian-deadlift: Back on a bench, bar across the hips, ceiling in view = hip thrust; standing with the floor in view = RDL.
barbell-overhead-press|shoulder-press-ma: A free bar rising past the eyes = overhead press; handles fixed to a machine frame = machine press.
bulgarian-split-squat|goblet-squat: Both feet on the floor, dumbbell at the chest = goblet; one foot behind on a bench = split squat.
bulgarian-split-squat|walking-lunge: Rear foot on a bench, same spot every rep = split squat; the floor travels forward each rep = walking lunge.
cable-biceps-curl|dumbbell-biceps-curl: Trace the cable: a cable from the handle to a stack = cable curl; free dumbbells = dumbbell curl.
cable-biceps-curl|triceps-cable-pushdown: Handle rises toward the chin = curl; handle is pushed down to the thighs with elbows pinned = pushdown.
cable-lateral-raise|dumbbell-lateral-rai: A cable running to a low pulley = cable raise; a dumbbell in the hand = dumbbell raise.
chest-press-machine|shoulder-press-machi: Handles push forward at chest height = chest press; handles push up past the ears = shoulder press.
chin-up|pull-up: Palms facing you, bar close under the chin = chin-up; palms away, wider grip = pull-up.
dip|push-up: Floor rushes toward the face = push-up; parallel bars beside the hips and the floor far below = dip.
dumbbell-bench-press|dumbbell-fly: Elbows bend and the dumbbells stay above the chest = press; arms nearly straight, dumbbells sweep wide out of frame = fly.
dumbbell-biceps-curl|dumbbell-front-rais: Elbow bends and the dumbbell stays close to the chest = curl; straight arm, dumbbell out at arm's length = front raise.
dumbbell-biceps-curl|dumbbell-lateral-ra: Dumbbell rises in front, close to the body = curl; out to the side at shoulder height, arm straight = lateral raise.
dumbbell-fly|dumbbell-pullover: One dumbbell overhead behind the head = pullover; two dumbbells sweeping wide = fly.
dumbbell-front-raise|dumbbell-lateral-ra: Front raise ends in front of the eyes; lateral raise ends out of frame to the sides.
dumbbell-front-raise|dumbbell-shoulder-p: Dumbbells start at the ears and go overhead = press; start at the thighs and stop at eye level = front raise.
dumbbell-row|seated-cable-row: Seated with a cable to a stack = cable row; standing bent over with a dumbbell = dumbbell row.
hack-squat-machine|leg-press: Lying back with the platform above = leg press; standing on a sled with shoulder pads = hack squat.
lat-pulldown|seated-cable-row: Bar comes down from above toward the chest = pulldown; handle comes from in front at chest height = row.
leg-extension|seated-leg-curl: Feet swing up in front (shins visible) = extension; heels pull back under the seat = leg curl.
